list.description: SAP registration, change, transfer, retirement and sale requests with approval (department manager → asset accountant → SAP posting)
list.search: Request no., asset tag, SAP asset no.

detail.notFound: The request does not exist or is outside your scope.
detail.cancelMessage: Pending approval steps and any waiting SAP posting are cancelled too.
detail.submitted: Submitted. Waiting for the department manager.
detail.noApprovals: Approval steps are created on submit.
detail.rejectedNote: This request was rejected. The asset was not changed. Create a new request if needed.
detail.postErrorNote: SAP posting failed. The asset accountant fixes and retries it in SAP integration.
detail.localOnly: Not an SAP asset, so it is applied in ALM right after final approval.
detail.noPosting: The SAP posting is created after final approval.
detail.finalMessage: Once approved it is queued for SAP posting (or applied right away for non-SAP assets) and cannot be undone.
detail.proxyNote: This cost center has no department manager, so an asset accountant decides step 1 instead. Step 2 must be approved by a different asset accountant.
detail.noSapPosting: This company does not use SAP, so the request is applied in ALM after approval.
detail.noApproval: This company has no approval steps; the request is applied on submit.

form.sameCostCenter: Same as the current cost center
form.nothingChanged: Enter at least one value to change
form.localHint: Not an SAP asset, so it is applied in ALM right after approval.

hint.NEW_ASSET: Creates the fixed asset in SAP after approval (AS01).
hint.TRANSFER: Moves the cost center. ABUMN transfer if the profit center changes.
hint.RETIRE: Scrap or loss (ABAVN). Retired after approval and posting.
hint.SALE: Sale (ABAON). Disposed after approval and posting.

fix.title: Fix posting error
fix.queueNote: Technical changes go straight back to the posting queue.
fix.reapprovalNote: Changing accounting values such as amounts or retirement type restarts approval. You cannot approve your own fix.
fix.queued: Fixed and queued for posting again.

company.title: Companies & SAP integration
company.description: Set SAP integration and asset request approval steps per company code. With SAP off, SAP fields and features are hidden and requests are applied in ALM after approval.
company.name: Name

stepsLabel.0: No approval · asset manager applies directly

company.sapOnlyTwo: Companies with SAP integration use 2 steps only.
company.offWarn: Turning it off rejects SAP connection calls for this company and hides SAP registration, postings and book values. It cannot be turned off while SAP postings are pending.
company.registerHint: Add a company that does not use SAP. SAP companies arrive through SAP master data (IF-MD-01).

fin.title: Cost centers & asset classes
fin.description: Maintain cost centers and asset classes for companies that do not use SAP. SAP cost centers and SAP asset classes come from SAP and are read-only.
fin.needNoSapCompany: To add one, first create a company with SAP integration off in Administration > Companies & SAP.
fin.classHint: Manual classes cannot be used for SAP registration.
fin.classSapOnly: Asset classes are received from SAP (IF-MD-01) only and cannot be added or changed in ALM.

sap.description: SAP interface status, run logs, posting queue (retry, cancel), reconciliation differences and field mappings. ALM never calls SAP; SAP jobs call the ALM API.
sap.runRequested: Requested {{iface}}. The SAP 15-minute job picks it up.
sap.noConnection: No connection for a company that uses SAP.
sap.searchPosting: Posting no., asset tag, SAP asset no.
sap.confirmChecked: I checked SAP (document and asset) and it was not posted
sap.cancelMessage: The linked request is cancelled too. Nothing is sent to SAP.
sap.fixHint: If it failed because of a wrong value, fix it with 'Fix posting error' on the linked request.
sap.noRecon: No reconciliation runs yet. They appear after the weekly SAP reconciliation (IF-RC-01).
sap.connectionHint: Register connections and rotate secrets with the CloudShell commands in runbook 13.
sap.staleClaim: The SAP job took this posting and its lock ended at {{at}} without a result. Check in SAP (AW01N/FB03) that nothing was posted before cancelling.
sap.claimedUntil: Being processed by the SAP job (locked until {{at}}).

dm.title: Department managers
dm.description: Manage the department manager (step-1 approver) and contact details for each cost center. Transfers are approved by the sending department, then the receiving department, then the asset accountant.
dm.search: Search cost center, name or manager
dm.sapNote: The SAP person responsible (KS02) is for reference only. Approvers are the department managers assigned here.
dm.noneNote: No department manager. An asset accountant approves step 1 on their behalf (for transfers, only the other department approves if it has a manager).
dm.removeMessage: Removes only the department manager assignment for {{cc}}. The user account stays.
dm.emailNewHint: A new user is created if none exists (name required). Linked at first SSO sign-in.
dm.name: Name
dm.dateOrder: Must be on or after the start date

list.description: Plan physical counts by site, assign rooms to counters, follow PDA scanning, resolve variances and post the count date to SAP.

create.note: The campaign starts in Scoping. Assign a counter to every room, then start counting.
create.dueHint: Due date must be on or after the key date

detail.unassigned: {{n}} room(s) have no counter yet. Assign every room before starting.

act.startMsg: The scope is frozen and count items are created for every asset in scope. Counters see their rooms on the PDA.
act.closeCountingMsg: {{pending}} asset(s) not yet counted will be marked Not found. PDA scans stop except for recounts.
act.postMsgSap: Creates a SAP posting (last count date) for every counted SAP asset. Assets without SAP are updated in ALM right away.
act.postMsg: Updates the last count date of every counted asset.
act.closeMsg: Closes the campaign once every SAP posting is done.
act.cancelMsg: The campaign is cancelled. Scans already received are kept.

rooms.noCounters: No user has the Counter role. Add the role in user administration first.
rooms.empty: No rooms in scope. Check that the assets in scope have a room.

var.help: Select rows, then choose an action that fits all of them. Room changes and retirements create requests that follow the normal approval flow.

tax.description: Business personal property tax: filing workpapers by county, estimated tax and past filings. Values are estimates — confirm factor tables and millage with each jurisdiction.
tax.empty: No property tax filings yet. Set up jurisdictions, then create a filing.
tax.createNote: Assets at the jurisdiction's sites that the company held on the lien date are listed with cost (SAP acquisition value, else ALM purchase cost) × factor.
tax.noJurisdictions: No jurisdictions yet. Add one in the Jurisdictions tab.
tax.notTaxable: {{state}} does not tax business personal property. The listing is for reference only.
tax.jurisdictionNote: Each site belongs to one jurisdiction. Defaults come from the state presets (researched Oct 2026).
tax.countyHint: For TX, use the appraisal district.
tax.millageHint: Tax per $1,000 of assessed value (county + city + school)
tax.loadReferenceMsg: Copy the researched {{set}} table into your tables? A table of the same year is replaced.
tax.genericNote: GENERIC_SL needs no table: factor = 1 − (age + 0.5) ÷ life, at least 20%. Enter the appraisal district schedule as a table for a closer estimate.
tax.noTable: No table yet. Load the reference table or enter the jurisdiction's table.
tax.ageNote: Age = tax year − year acquired (first age {{start}}). Ages past the table use the last value.
tax.classMapNote: Without a mapping, the class comes from the category (or asset class) useful life.
tax.disclaimer: Estimate only. Confirm values, factor tables, exemptions and millage with the jurisdiction before filing.

detail.firstYear: No prior-year filing, so every asset is an addition.

act.regenerateMsg: Recalculate from the current assets, jurisdiction and factor tables? The asset list is replaced.
act.fileNote: After filing, the asset list is frozen and kept as history.
act.assessNote: Enter the assessed value and tax from the county notice.
act.reopenMsg: Return this filing to draft to correct it?

tax.futureLien: The lien date is in the future: estimated from assets held today
tax.includeVehicles: Include vehicles (TX renders business vehicles; GA/AL/CA tax them at registration)

ptype.LEASED_IN: Leased from others (listed on the return, not taxed to you)

tax.ptypeNote: Every asset at a jurisdiction's sites is reported by property type. Category beats asset class; unset classes are guessed from the class name. Real property, intangible and excluded are never reported; vehicles, CIP and leasehold improvements follow the jurisdiction; equipment leased from others is listed on the return but not taxed to you. Inventory and supplies are not tracked in ALM.
tax.ptypeCategoriesNote: Set only when a category differs from its asset class.
tax.includeLeasehold: Include leasehold improvements (GA: improvements that become part of the building are not personal property; trade fixtures go in Schedule A)

warn.OLD_FACTOR_TABLE: No {{taxYear}} factor table, so the {{tableYear}} table was used.
warn.UNVERIFIED_FACTORS: The factor table is an unverified reference. Compare it with the jurisdiction's official table.
warn.NO_FACTOR_TABLE: No {{factorSet}} factor table, so factor 1.0 (cost as is) was used. Load or enter the factor table.
warn.GENERIC_FACTORS: Generic straight-line factors (20% floor). Enter the appraisal district's depreciation table for better accuracy.
warn.NO_JURISDICTION: {{count}} asset(s) with no site, or whose site is not linked to a jurisdiction, are in no filing ({{tags}}). Set the asset's site or link the site to a jurisdiction.
warn.EXCLUDED_TYPES: Left out as not reportable: {{types}}. Whether vehicles, CIP and leasehold improvements are included is set on the jurisdiction.
warn.LEASED_LISTED: {{count}} leased item(s) are left out of the tax and listed on the return's leased equipment schedule (Excel 'Leased equipment'). Fill in the owner (lessor) name and address.
warn.PROPERTY_TYPE_GUESSED: Asset classes with no property type ({{classes}}) were classified by name. Check them on the Property types tab.
warn.NO_FACTOR_CLASS: Classes not in the factor table ({{classes}}) used factor 1.0.
warn.UNKNOWN_COST: {{count}} asset(s) with no cost are left out of the totals (report them in the return's 'cost unknown' section at estimated value).
warn.ACQUIRED_AFTER_LIEN: {{count}} asset(s) acquired after the lien date ({{lienDate}}) are not in this year's filing (they belong to next year). Acquisition date is the SAP capitalization date → purchase date → ALM registration date.
warn.NO_ASSETS: This company has no assets at the sites linked to this jurisdiction. Check the site links on the Jurisdictions tab.
warn.ZERO_MILLAGE: Millage (tax rate) is 0, so the estimated tax is 0. Enter the county millage on the Jurisdictions tab.
warn.NOT_TAXABLE: {{state}} does not tax business personal property (no filing required). The listing is for reference.
warn.EXEMPT: Exempt because total fair market value is ${{amount}} or less (the return is still filed).

cat.name: Name
cat.description: Categories are defined in ALM (menu, models, CMDB, replacement life). Asset classes come from SAP only; pick one as the default for registration.
cat.codeHint: Letters, digits, _ . - (up to 20). Cannot be changed later.
cat.classHint: Only asset classes received from SAP (IF-MD-01).
cat.classUnavailable: not an SAP class — choose another
cat.usage: {{assets}} asset(s) and {{models}} model(s) use this category. In use or with active sub-categories it cannot be deactivated.
cat.deleteMsg: Delete category {{name}}? Its models are deleted too. Categories used by assets cannot be deleted.
